title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-05
lineage: MSR> CASS> DAT> CDR> EAC> FLAC
source: Soundboard (except where patched with low gen AUD as noted)

ai_review.summary: Solid soundboard capture of a lively June 5 1970 show with jam‑filled Saint Stephen, Easy Wind and Man’s World, despite occasional audio patches.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its high energy – Saint Stephen is “fully jammed out” and the rare pairing of Easy Wind with Man's World delights fans. While the soundboard source is generally good, listeners note some patchy moments and recommend EQ adjustments; overall the recording remains enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive comments about the musical set with only minor audio issues lead to a high rating; five detailed reviews provide strong evidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio has occasional patchy moments and may need EQ tweaks, but overall clarity is solid and the audience portion captured well.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows strongly with high‑energy jams; humor from on‑stage moments (e.g., Mickey being heckled) adds character despite minor performance hiccups.

band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey (Bear) gets heckled and appears stressed, creating a humorous on‑stage moment.
